a vague idea: I only have a vague idea of what the exam will cover, so I need to ask the teacher for details.
我對考試範圍只有模糊的概念，所以我需要問老師細節。
vague promises: The politician made vague promises about better jobs but never explained how he would create them.
這位政客做出關於更好工作的含糊的承諾，但從未解釋他要如何創造這些工作。
a vague memory: I have a vague memory of visiting the beach as a small child, but I can't recall any details.
我對小時候去海邊有模糊的記憶，但想不起任何細節。
be vague about: When I asked where he went last night, he was vague about it and quickly changed the subject.
當我問他昨晚去哪裡時，他對此含糊其辭，並很快轉移話題。
a vague sense of unease: Walking home alone in the dark, she had a vague sense of unease, though she couldn't say why.
獨自在黑暗中走路回家時，她有種隱約的不安，雖然她說不出為什麼。
vague terms: The contract was written in vague terms, so neither side was sure what they had actually agreed to.
合約以模糊的措辭寫成，所以雙方都不確定他們究竟同意了什麼。
in vain: We searched for the lost cat for hours, but it was in vain; we never found her.
我們找那隻走失的貓好幾個小時，但徒勞無功；我們始終沒找到她。
a vain attempt: In a vain attempt to catch the last train, he ran up the stairs, but the doors had already closed.
他徒勞的嘗試趕上末班車，跑上樓梯，但車門已經關上了。
a vain hope: Waiting for the rain to stop before the game was a vain hope; it poured all afternoon.
在比賽前等雨停是無望的期望；整個下午都在下大雨。
be vain about one's looks: She is so vain about her looks that she checks her hair in the mirror every few minutes.
她對外貌如此自負，以至於每隔幾分鐘就照鏡子檢查頭髮。
try in vain to: He tried in vain to open the old door; no matter how hard he pushed, it would not move.
他徒勞地試圖打開那扇舊門；無論他多用力推，門都動也不動。
a valid passport: To travel to Japan, you need a valid passport that has not expired and a return ticket.
要去日本旅行，你需要一本尚未過期的有效護照和一張回程票。
a valid point: My classmate made a valid point in the debate, and even the other team had to agree with her.
我的同學在辯論中提出有道理的論點，連對方隊伍都不得不同意她。
a valid reason: Students who miss the test without a valid reason, such as illness, will receive a zero.
沒有正當的理由（例如生病）而缺考的學生將得到零分。
a valid argument: Her essay presented a valid argument supported by facts, so the judges gave her the highest score.
她的文章提出一個有事實支持、站得住腳的論點，所以評審給她最高分。
be valid for one year: This student bus card is valid for one year, so you must renew it after it expires next September.
這張學生公車卡有效期一年，所以你必須在明年九月到期後更新它。
a valid ticket: Passengers without a valid ticket will be asked to pay a fine when the conductor checks.
沒有有效票券的乘客在查票員查票時將被要求繳納罰款。
variable weather: Because of the variable weather in spring, it can be sunny in the morning and rainy by noon.
由於春天多變的天氣，可能早上晴朗，到了中午就下雨。
a variable rate: The bank offered a loan with a variable rate, which may go up or down every few months.
銀行提供浮動利率的貸款，每幾個月可能上升或下降。
be highly variable: The quality of food at that restaurant is highly variable; some days it's great and other days terrible.
那家餐廳的食物品質變化很大；有些日子很棒，有些日子很糟。
a variable of the experiment: In our science class, the amount of sunlight was the only variable of the experiment we changed.
在我們的科學課上，陽光的量是我們唯一改變的實驗變數。
for various reasons: For various reasons, including money, time, and health, many people give up their plans to travel abroad.
出於各種原因，包括金錢、時間和健康，許多人放棄出國旅行的計畫。
at various times: I have visited that museum at various times of the year, and each season offers a different exhibition.
我在一年中的不同時間參觀過那間博物館，每個季節都有不同的展覽。
various kinds of: The night market sells various kinds of snacks, from stinky tofu to bubble tea and fried chicken.
夜市販賣各種各類的小吃，從臭豆腐到珍珠奶茶和炸雞。
the various stages: The teacher explained the various stages of a butterfly's life, from egg to caterpillar to adult.
老師解釋了蝴蝶生命的各個階段，從卵到毛毛蟲再到成蟲。
a vast majority: A vast majority of the students, about ninety-five percent, voted for longer lunch breaks.
絕大多數的學生，大約百分之九十五，投票支持更長的午休時間。
vast amounts of: Data centers use vast amounts of electricity, as much as a small city uses in a year.
資料中心使用大量的電力，多達一座小城市一年的用電量。
a vast improvement: His second essay was a vast improvement over the first; his score jumped from 40 to 90.
他的第二篇文章比第一篇有巨大的改善；他的分數從40分跳到90分。
vast experience: With vast experience from thirty years of teaching, Mr. Lin knows how to help every kind of student.
憑藉三十年教學累積的豐富的經驗，林老師知道如何幫助各種學生。
vast areas: The forest fire burned vast areas of land, covering thousands of square kilometers.
森林大火燒毀了廣大的地區，面積達數千平方公里。
a vast sum of money: The billionaire donated a vast sum of money, over one hundred million dollars, to build new hospitals.
這位億萬富翁捐出巨額金錢，超過一億美元，來興建新醫院。
